note: A snapshot of Riftland's router and model cards. The live answer is models_explore with action recommended or get, and guide (MCP), or riftland models --recommended (CLI). Do not hard-code a model from it.

recommended.when: A realistic photograph of a subject or scene with no special style or product focus.
A person is the subject: headshot, editorial or character portrait.
A single frame that looks taken from a feature film: mood, wide frame, motivated light.
An object or packaged product is the hero: catalog, e-commerce or brand imagery.
A product or person shown in a believable everyday situation, candid and warm.
A scroll-stopping image made for a feed: bold subject, clear focal point, room for a caption.
Legible text is the point: poster, cover, banner, title card or any layout with words.
A logo, icon, emblem or flat vector graphic on a plain background.
recommended.reason: Best for logos and vector graphics

recommended.when: A drawn or painted image, not a photograph: cartoon, editorial, concept art, picture-book.
Change one thing in an existing image and keep everything else exactly as it is.
A film-like clip of one scene or a short sequence: deliberate camera move, mood, natural sound.
A short vertical clip for Reels, TikTok or Shorts: fast hook, strong motion, sound on.
A short clip that shows a product clearly: reveal, rotation, use in hand or on a surface.
Bring a given still image to life while keeping its subject and look unchanged.
A short clip that ends where it starts, for backgrounds, banners or ambient visuals.
